statement: 3 rank-one oscillators admit 6 real equilibria modulo common phase. This attains the complex bound.

source.location: Corollary 4.9 (even n); Theorem 4.12 (odd n); Corollary 4.4 (complex bound)

origin.inheritance_basis: Set n=3 in the explicit real-equilibrium construction.

notes: Coss et al., Section 4.1, explicitly note that the maximum6 for three oscillators was known, citing Baillieul–Byrnes 1982 and Xin–Kikkawa–Liu 2016. This record uses their construction as verification, not as a new discovery of that small case.
